# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > A mixed collection documenting viral internet culture and scientific content, primarily featuring TikTok trends, exploitable memes, and viral video explanations from Know Your Meme.

This site aggregates content from Know Your Meme's documentation of internet culture phenomena and Scientific American's scientific journalism. The majority of content focuses on explaining viral TikTok trends, image macros, catchphrases, and social media memes that have gained widespread attention across platforms like TikTok, Twitter, and Instagram.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends
- Viral memes
- Exploitable memes
- Image macros
- Viral videos
- Internet catchphrases
- Social media culture
- Meme explainers
- Dance trends
- Know Your Meme
- TikTok
- DeviantArt
- Breaking Bad memes
- Hood movie nostalgia

- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean? The Viral '90s Hood... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Explainer on Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend on TikTok/Instagram
- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl? The Viral Memes About Somali-American ICE Vi... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Viral meme explainer about Nasra Ahmed's ICE detention speech in Minneapolis
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' song catchphrase

## Exploitable Memes & Image Macros

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl over cat, viral on TikTok
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White and Jesse Pinkman

## Scientific American Content

- [Call for Proposals: "The Protectors" A Documentary Series by Scientific American | Scientific American](https://scientificamerican.com/page/call-for-proposals-the-protectors-a-documentary-series-by-scientific-american): Film grant opportunity for wildlife conservation documentaries, up to $80K
